text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 02 · 山顶天文台观景台.
Environment:  An original small hilltop Art Deco observatory terrace above hazy Los Angeles, soft luminous late afternoon well before sunset. Curving ivory parapet, pale stone paving, one simple warm-brown bench and a small coin-operated brass telescope to right; pale cream observatory dome partially visible far left, distant gray city layers. Sparse pale sage landscaping. Eye-level from terrace entrance, inviting clear center space, delicate pale lilac blue sky, no orange sunset. A feeling of anticipation, architectural realism.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 02 · 山顶天文台观景台. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One flat architectural orthographic main facade elevation or interior principal wall elevation. Show openings, structural bays, vertical proportions, ceiling profile and material detail. No perspective montage, no furniture moved against the elevation. White page, title INTERIOR ELEVATION or FRONT ELEVATION. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
